sanskrit:
मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते।
स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान्ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते।।
caption:
Chapter 14, Verse 26

Kṛṣṇa answers: The Method. ‘māṁ ca yo ’vyabhicāreṇa bhakti-yogena sevate’ (One who engages in full devotional service, unfailing in all circumstances). ‘sa guṇān samatītyaitān’ (At once transcends the modes of material nature). ‘brahmā-bhūyāya kalpate’ (And comes to the level of Brahman). This is the secret. You cannot fight the modes with your own strength (Passion vs. Passion). You must hook yourself to a higher power. Bhakti Yoga is the helicopter that lifts you out of the forest of Gunas. The moment you serve Kṛṣṇa (‘Sevate’), you are out of the material atmosphere.
